title: Lifting materials to roofs and floors
lines: Blocks, tiles, building supplies – to the second floor and the roof.
Instead of carrying them upstairs, the crane lifts a whole pallet.
A ground signaller guides, and nobody stands under the load.
We check weight, reach and access before we arrive.
It saves work days and the whole crew's backs.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. We lift the work for you.
